name: Duplicate Bitnami Legacy images

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  copy-docker-images:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_HUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Log in to GHCR
        run: echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin

      - name: Install skopeo
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y skopeo
      
      - name: Copy images
        run: |
          while IFS= read -r IMAGE; do
            if [ -z "$IMAGE" ]; then continue; fi  # Skip empty lines
            DEST_IMAGE="ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/$(basename $IMAGE)"
            echo "Checking if $DEST_IMAGE exists..."
            if skopeo inspect docker://"$DEST_IMAGE" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "$DEST_IMAGE already exists, skipping..."
            else
              echo "Copying $IMAGE to $DEST_IMAGE"
              skopeo copy --multi-arch all --preserve-digests docker://"$IMAGE" docker://"$DEST_IMAGE"
            fi
          done < "list_of_images.txt"

# Bitnami Legacy

Mirror of handpicked Bitnami Legacy images
